correctness.rationale: The 12 Latin-square incidence vectors are enumerated in two exhaustive ways; an eight-dimensional affine difference quotient is constructed exactly. Exhaustive integer checks by direct character sums, an independent Walsh transform, and ambient representative sums agree on all 256 coefficients and both Parseval tests. A second full transform calculates the exact projector kernel; translation averaging proves norm-optimality among arbitrary endpoint projections. Only the 27-coordinate order-three domain is claimed.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial order-three Latin-square triple-incidence orbit is a canonical finite design family. Its complete binary Fourier frequency support identifies the precise convolution nullspace and establishes a sharp recoverability/stability invariant. Endpoint projection amplification 31/4 despite positive Hilbert spectral condition 3 is a substantive contrast not entailed by the known cardinality 12, and provides a precise benchmark for structured-incidence Fourier inversion. No larger-order extrapolation is claimed.
